properties.traits: A follower of a secret cult. Believes what they worship protects them, and may know an incantation.

properties.dread: A moderate loss: its gait is far too close to a man's.
properties.traits: A grey-scaled being from the depths, out of a sunken city off the coast. Breathes underwater; thick skin.

properties.dread: A small loss at first sight, more when it is seen feeding.
properties.traits: A stooped, dog-faced creature haunting graveyards and the tunnels under the city. Smells of damp earth; moves without a sound in the dark.

properties.dread: A moderate loss, worse when one finds out what it carries.
properties.traits: A winged fungal creature from beyond the stars, at strange work in lonely hills. Flies slowly; photographs only show a blur.
